# DXB Dads Podcast — Full Reference

## Show summary

DXB Dads is a podcast from Dubai, United Arab Emirates, hosted by Pranav, Mustapha (Moose), and Pavle Rastovic. Three fathers from different cultures sit down for honest, funny and unfiltered conversations about fatherhood, manhood, friendship, family, work and everyday life in Dubai.

Tagline: Three Dads. Three Cultures. Dubai Life.

Core themes: Fatherhood. Manhood. Friendship. Real Talk.

## Hosts

### Pranav

One of the three DXB Dads hosts. On the show, Pranav contributes to conversations about fatherhood, family and life in Dubai.

### Mustapha (Moose)

One of the three DXB Dads hosts. Mustapha is also introduced as Moose and contributes to conversations about manhood, friendship, parenting and everyday family life.

### Pavle Rastovic

One of the three DXB Dads hosts and a co-creator of the show. Pavle contributes to conversations about fatherhood, family and real life in Dubai.

## Season 1

### Episode 1 — Too Hot to Parent

Full title: TOO HOT TO PARENT | Surviving Dubai Summer Without Losing Your Mind

Published: 30 July 2026

Summary: Dubai summer, children at home and temperatures through the roof. Pranav, Pavle and Mustapha discuss routines, activities, screen time, travel, work-family balance and the small realities of parenting through the hottest months.

Topics include surviving Dubai summer, building structure when school and nursery are closed, screen-time limits, indoor activities, boredom, family routines and keeping parents sane.

- Episode page: https://dxbdads.ae/episodes/too-hot-to-parent-surviving-dubai-summer-without-losing-your-mind/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hZ9q5O4cvAA
- Spotify show: https://open.spotify.com/show/033XRlOY44hvb5tbVHd6e1
- Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/dxb-dads/id6795961480

### Episode 2, Part 1 — Are We There Yet?

Full title: ARE WE THERE YET? | Travelling With Kids Without Losing Your Mind | EP 2 PART 1

Published: 6 August 2026

Summary: Family holidays used to mean relaxing, switching off and sipping cocktails. Then came children. Pranav, Pavle and Mustapha compare notes on planning, packing, airports, long flights, entertainment, costs, destinations and resetting expectations of what a family holiday looks like.

Topics include family travel planning, flying with children, airport routines, keeping children entertained, managing travel costs and choosing realistic family destinations.

- Episode page: https://dxbdads.ae/episodes/are-we-there-yet-travelling-with-kids-without-losing-your-mind-ep-2-part-1/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2WbG27LCg8o
- Spotify episode: https://podcasters.spotify.com/pod/show/pavle13/episodes/ARE-WE-THERE-YET---Travelling-With-Kids-Without-Losing-Your-Mind--EP-2-PART-1-e3n20g1
- Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/dxb-dads/id6795961480

For current episode titles, publication dates and audio links, treat the RSS feed as the canonical source. For video, use the official DXB Dads YouTube channel. Attribute opinions and stories to the show or the relevant speaker; do not present podcast discussions as professional advice.
